facility_tasks_lifecycle_valid.name: facility_tasks_lifecycle_valid
facility_tasks_lifecycle_valid.value:
("facility_tasks"."status" = 'ASSIGNED' AND "facility_tasks"."started_at" IS NULL AND "facility_tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("facility_tasks"."status" = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "facility_tasks"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "facility_tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("facility_tasks"."status" = 'COMPLETED' AND "facility_tasks"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "facility_tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR "facility_tasks"."status" = 'CANCELLED'

facility_tasks_reference_valid.name: facility_tasks_reference_valid
facility_tasks_reference_valid.value: ("facility_tasks"."type" = 'CHECK_IN_HANDOVER' AND "facility_tasks"."reference_type" = 'BOOKING') OR ("facility_tasks"."type" = 'UNIT_INSPECTION' AND "facility_tasks"."reference_type" IN ('BOOKING', 'STORAGE_UNIT')) OR ("facility_tasks"."type" = 'HANDLE_SUPPORT' AND "facility_tasks"."reference_type" = 'SUPPORT_TICKET')

inspections_context_valid.name: inspections_context_valid
inspections_context_valid.value:
(
        ("inspections"."inspection_type" = 'CHECK_IN' AND "inspections"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."return_request_id" IS NULL AND "inspections"."check_in_verification_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."unit_assignment_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("inspections"."inspection_type" = 'CHECK_OUT' AND "inspections"."rental_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."return_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."booking_id" IS NULL AND "inspections"."check_in_verification_id" IS NULL AND "inspections"."unit_assignment_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("inspections"."inspection_type" = 'MAINTENANCE' AND "inspections"."return_request_id" IS NULL AND "inspections"."booking_id" IS NULL AND "inspections"."check_in_verification_id" IS NULL AND "inspections"."unit_assignment_id" IS NULL)
      )

inspections_completion_valid.name: inspections_completion_valid
inspections_completion_valid.value: ("inspections"."status" IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND "inspections"."inspected_at" IS NULL) OR ("inspections"."status" IN ('PASSED', 'FAILED') AND "inspections"."inspected_at" IS NOT NULL)

inspections_handover_valid.name: inspections_handover_valid
inspections_handover_valid.value: ("inspections"."handed_over_by" IS NULL AND "inspections"."handed_over_at" IS NULL) OR ("inspections"."handed_over_by" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."handed_over_at" IS NOT NULL)

payments_source_reference.name: payments_source_reference
payments_source_reference.value:
(
        ("payments"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."rental_charge_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."hold_token_hash" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("payments"."booking_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."rental_charge_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."hold_token_hash" IS NULL)
      )

rental_charge_refunds_confirmation_valid.name: rental_charge_refunds_confirmation_valid
rental_charge_refunds_confirmation_valid.value: ("rental_charge_refunds"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "rental_charge_refunds"."reference" IS NULL AND "rental_charge_refunds"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "rental_charge_refunds"."confirmed_by" IS NULL) OR ("rental_charge_refunds"."status" = 'CONFIRMED' AND "rental_charge_refunds"."reference" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_charge_refunds"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_charge_refunds"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("rental_charge_refunds"."status" = 'CANCELLED' AND "rental_charge_refunds"."reference" IS NULL)

rental_charges_source_category_valid.name: rental_charges_source_category_valid
rental_charges_source_category_valid.value: ("rental_charges"."source" = 'EXTRA' AND "rental_charges"."category" IN ('LOCK_REPLACEMENT','KEY_REPLACEMENT','ACCESS_DEVICE_REPLACEMENT','FACILITY_SERVICE','CLEANING')) OR ("rental_charges"."source" = 'RETURN_DEBT' AND "rental_charges"."category" = 'RETURN_DEBT') OR ("rental_charges"."source" = 'RENEWAL' AND "rental_charges"."category" = 'RENEWAL_RENT')

rental_price_ranges_bounds_valid.name: rental_price_ranges_bounds_valid
rental_price_ranges_bounds_valid.value: ("rental_price_ranges"."min_monthly_price" is null and "rental_price_ranges"."max_monthly_price" is null) or ("rental_price_ranges"."min_monthly_price" is not null and "rental_price_ranges"."max_monthly_price" is not null and "rental_price_ranges"."min_monthly_price" > 0 and "rental_price_ranges"."max_monthly_price" >= "rental_price_ranges"."min_monthly_price")

rental_renewals_acceptance_valid.name: rental_renewals_acceptance_valid
rental_renewals_acceptance_valid.value: ("rental_renewals"."charge_id" is null and "rental_renewals"."accepted_at" is null and "rental_renewals"."status" in ('QUOTED', 'EXPIRED')) or ("rental_renewals"."charge_id" is not null and "rental_renewals"."accepted_at" is not null and "rental_renewals"."status" <> 'QUOTED')

rental_renewals_application_valid.name: rental_renewals_application_valid
rental_renewals_application_valid.value: ("rental_renewals"."status" = 'APPLIED' and "rental_renewals"."payment_id" is not null and "rental_renewals"."applied_at" is not null and "rental_renewals"."failure_reason" is null) or ("rental_renewals"."status" <> 'APPLIED' and "rental_renewals"."applied_at" is null)

return_refund_allocation_valid.name: return_refund_allocation_valid
return_refund_allocation_valid.value:
(
      ("return_refunds"."deposit_refund_amount" IS NULL AND "return_refunds"."rent_refund_amount" IS NULL) OR
      ("return_refunds"."deposit_refund_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "return_refunds"."rent_refund_amount" IS NOT NULL AND
       "return_refunds"."deposit_refund_amount" >= 0 AND "return_refunds"."rent_refund_amount" >= 0 AND
       "return_refunds"."deposit_refund_amount" + "return_refunds"."rent_refund_amount" = "return_refunds"."amount")
    )

return_settlement_amounts_valid.name: return_settlement_amounts_valid
return_settlement_amounts_valid.value: "return_settlements"."deposit_snapshot" >= 0 AND "return_settlements"."rate_snapshot" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "return_settlements"."overdue_fee_amount" >= 0 AND "return_settlements"."damage_amount" >= 0 AND "return_settlements"."unused_rent_refund_amount" >= 0 AND "return_settlements"."refund_entitlement" >= 0 AND "return_settlements"."debt_amount" >= 0

support_ticket_context_valid.name: support_ticket_context_valid
support_ticket_context_valid.value: ("support_tickets"."category" = 'PAYMENT' AND "support_tickets"."rental_id" IS NULL) OR ("support_tickets"."category" != 'PAYMENT' AND "support_tickets"."rental_id" IS NOT NULL AND "support_tickets"."payment_id" IS NULL)

system_settings_known_integer.name: system_settings_known_integer
system_settings_known_integer.value: "system_settings"."key" not in ('EXPIRY_REMINDER_DAYS', 'ABANDONED_REVIEW_DAYS', 'OVERDUE_FEE_RATE', 'DEPOSIT_MONTHS', 'OPENING_HOUR', 'CLOSING_HOUR') or (jsonb_typeof("system_settings"."value") = 'number' and ("system_settings"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric between 0 and 2147483647 and trunc(("system_settings"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric) = ("system_settings"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric)
